title: Ohm Boy Pear, Apple & Raspberry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: For a taste of summer, Ohm Boy have captured the season to perfection in an exquisite e-liquid from their celebrated Botanicals range. Pear, Apple and Raspberry delivers a fresh and flavoursome hit of an English orchard and hedgerow, with soft, sweet pears, crisp, juicy apples, and a tart and tangy layer of plump raspberries. This juice is so perfectly crafted you can taste each distinct, delicious fruit, but together they create a sensational flavour that could easily become a fruit lover’s favourite all-day vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
